actions.message: Great job on your high contribution! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Average contribution fell below 30%, triggering extra contribution, but constitution requires punishing Resident3 for two consecutive <10% contributions. Chose punishment as the single physical action and sent praise to Resident4 for cooperation.
